scope: Prevent an unguarded outer-vector allocation while parsing a bounded DWG MESH face stream; do not alter or qualify the wire layout.

change.behavior: After readCount validates the face stream item count, reserve parsedFaces to that count before constructing faces. Since each face consumes at least its count item, this bounds the maximum outer-vector element count. DRW::reserve catches allocation failure and the existing record failure path invalidates the frame and clears typed state.
change.testControl: The generated AC1024 MESH vector now includes an optional triangle and verifies the face index sequence after parsing. Existing malformed crease-count refusal and corrected same-object retry remain in the focused selector.

specReview.check: Extracted searchable text and searched for SubDMesh / sub-d mesh / mesh entity; no matching layout entry was found.
specReview.effect: No DWG field order, count semantics, or support claim is changed based on an undocumented layout.

coverage: Generated AC1024 triangle face stream decodes to ordered indices {0,1,2}.
Existing one-edge/one-crease physical-layout vector still reads successfully.
Existing over-edge crease-count frame is refused, clears partial state, and permits corrected same-object retry.
No allocation-failure injection was performed; the guard uses the shared exception-catching reserve helper before any face push.

limitations: This is a bounded allocation-safety improvement, not an independently verified MESH DWG-layout result.
Native subdivision, crease behavior, rendering, and 3D semantic meaning remain unqualified.

repositoryState.stagedScope: bounded MESH DWG parse/output profile; DXF loss guards; generated vectors
